1.t: Woe to those who give short measure,

2.t: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,

3.t: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!

4.t: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up

6.t: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

7.t: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––

8.t: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––

10.t: Woe on that day to the deniers,

11.t: those who deny the Day of Judgement!

12.t: Only the evil aggressor denies it:

13.t: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’

14.t: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.

15.t: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,

17.t: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’

18.t: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––

19.t: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––

22.t: The truly good will live in bliss,

24.t: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.

25.t: They will be served a sealed nectar,

26.t: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––

27.t: mixed with the water of Tasnim,

28.t: a spring from which those brought near will drink.

29.t: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––

30.t: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,

31.t: joke about them when they got back to their own people,

32.t: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’

33.t: though they were not sent to be their keepers-

34.t: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers

35.t: as they sit on couches, gazing around.

36.t: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
